<b>Yagos</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Fierce flying warriors that throw blades with expert precision, they are members of the [[Order of Karak]], long lost to time and living on only in memory.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Yagos naturally attempt to maintain a large, diagonal aerial distance from Hornet, and backs away as she moves closer.
* <b>Spinning Spike Throw:</b> The Yago throws a spinning projectile at Hornet in a heavy arc. It can be destroyed by [[Tools]] such as the [[Pimpillo]] or [[Voltvessels]], or deflected with a [[Needle]] attack or [[Silk Skill]]. The deflected projectile can hit enemies, dealing the same amount of damage that a needle hit would.
* <b>Spinning Slash:</b> The Yago spins its blade around itself and does a short, downwards-diagonal dash towards Hornet dealing {{Damage|1+1}}. This attack only happens if Hornet is very close to the Yago.
* <b> Follow-up Dash:</b> After either of the two moves above, the Yago may perform a short dash backwards and hold for a moment, and then perform either of the two moves above with much less warning.
* <b>Evade:</b> Dashes backwards away from Hornet.

== Location ==
Yagos can only be found in [[Crust King Khann]]'s [[Elegy of the Deep|Memory]] of the [[Coral Tower]] during [[Acts|Act 3]].
